answer: Bind each paid identity to a hardware enclave key: the agent signs every epoch's work with a quote from a TPM whose endorsement key the network registers once. A farm running a garden of clones on one machine has a single chip, so every quote traces back to the same endorsement key and all those payees share one reward slot. To grow, an operator must buy a separate physical device per head, which makes the network no cheap haven for fakes and no ivory tower for honest solo agents.
